1.desc: Distribution of Oracle Wait Classes in Percent
1.sql:
WITH aas AS (
    SELECT n.wait_class                                AS wait_class,
           m.time_waited / NULLIF(m.intsize_csec, 0)   AS aas
    FROM   v$waitclassmetric m
    JOIN   v$system_wait_class n ON n.wait_class_id = m.wait_class_id
    WHERE  n.wait_class <> 'Idle'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CPU', value / 100
    FROM   v$sysmetric
    WHERE  metric_name = 'CPU Usage Per Sec'
      AND  group_id = 2
)
SELECT
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'CPU' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%CPU",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'User I/O' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%USER I/O",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'System I/O' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%SYSTEM I/O",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Commit' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%COMMIT",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Application' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%APPLICATION",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Concurrency' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%CONCURRENCY",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Configuration' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%CONFIGURATION",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Administrative' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%ADMINISTRATIVE",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Network' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%NETWORK",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Scheduler' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%SCHEDULER",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class = 'Other' THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%OTHER",
       ROUND(100 * NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN wait_class IN ('Commit', 'User I/O', 'System I/O') THEN aas END), 0)
             / NULLIF(SUM(aas), 0), 2) AS "%IO SUMMARY"
FROM aas

2.desc: Output Storage Latency per Oracle IO Wait Class
2.sql:
WITH main_query AS (
			select wait_class,
			sum(m.wait_count)  cnt,
			10*sum(m.time_waited) ms,
			nvl(round(10*(sum(m.time_waited))/nullif(sum(m.wait_count),0),3) ,0) avg_ms
			from v$eventmetric m,
			v$event_name n
			where  m.event_id=n.event_id
			and wait_class in ('System I/O', 'User I/O', 'Commit')
			and m.wait_count > 0
			group by wait_class
			)
			SELECT      (SELECT y.avg_ms FROM main_query y WHERE y.wait_class = 'User I/O' ) AS "User I/O [ms]"
			,(SELECT y.avg_ms FROM main_query y WHERE y.wait_class = 'System I/O' ) AS "System I/O [ms]"
			,(SELECT y.avg_ms FROM main_query y WHERE y.wait_class = 'Commit' ) AS "Commit I/O [ms]"
			from DUAL

3.sql:
SELECT ts.tablespace_name,
       ts.contents,
       ROUND(df.alloc_bytes / 1048576, 2)                              AS "allocated MB",
       ROUND(df.max_bytes   / 1048576, 2)                              AS "max MB",
       ROUND(NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0) / 1048576, 2)                       AS "free in MB",
       ROUND((df.alloc_bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0)) / 1048576, 2)    AS "used in MB",
       ROUND(100 * (df.alloc_bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0))
             / NULLIF(df.alloc_bytes, 0), 2)                           AS "used % of alloc",
       ROUND(100 * (df.alloc_bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0))
             / NULLIF(df.max_bytes, 0), 2)                             AS "used %"
FROM   dba_tablespaces ts
JOIN   (SELECT tablespace_name,
               SUM(bytes) AS alloc_bytes,
               SUM(CASE WHEN autoextensible = 'YES' AND maxbytes > bytes
                        THEN maxbytes ELSE bytes END) AS max_bytes
        FROM   dba_data_files
        GROUP  BY tablespace_name
        UNION ALL
        SELECT tablespace_name,
               SUM(bytes),
               SUM(CASE WHEN autoextensible = 'YES' AND maxbytes > bytes
                        THEN maxbytes ELSE bytes END)
        FROM   dba_temp_files
        GROUP  BY tablespace_name) df ON df.tablespace_name = ts.tablespace_name
LEFT   JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) AS free_bytes
             FROM   dba_free_space
             GROUP  BY tablespace_name
             UNION ALL
             SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(free_space)
             FROM   dba_temp_free_space
             GROUP  BY tablespace_name) fs ON fs.tablespace_name = ts.tablespace_name
ORDER  BY 8 DESC NULLS LAST

8.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(alloc)          / 1073741824, 2) AS "DB Size in GB",
       ROUND(SUM(alloc - free)   / 1073741824, 2) AS "Used space in GB",
       ROUND(SUM(free)           / 1073741824, 2) AS "Free space in GB",
       ROUND(SUM(maxsize)        / 1073741824, 2) AS "Max Size in GB"
FROM (
    SELECT df.alloc, df.maxsize, NVL(fs.free, 0) AS free
    FROM   (SELECT tablespace_name,
                   SUM(bytes) AS alloc,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN autoextensible = 'YES' AND maxbytes > bytes
                            THEN maxbytes ELSE bytes END) AS maxsize
            FROM   dba_data_files
            GROUP  BY tablespace_name) df
    LEFT   JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) AS free
                 FROM   dba_free_space
                 GROUP  BY tablespace_name) fs
           ON fs.tablespace_name = df.tablespace_name
)

10.desc: Top SQL (24 hours) by total execution time
10.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT parsing_schema_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value,
           ROUND(elapsed_time / 1000000, 4)                             AS ELAPSED_TIME_SEC,
           executions,
           ROUND(elapsed_time / 1000000 / NULLIF(executions, 0), 4)     AS SINGLE_RUN_SEC,
           SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 400)                                     AS sql_text
    FROM   v$sql
    WHERE  executions > 0
      AND  last_active_time > SYSDATE - 1
      AND  parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','OUTLN','XDB','WMSYS','CTXSYS','MDSYS',
                                         'AUDSYS','OJVMSYS','APPQOSSYS','DVSYS','LBACSYS','ORDSYS','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL')
    ORDER  BY elapsed_time DESC
)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 100

11.desc: Top SQL (24 hours) by single execution time
11.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT parsing_schema_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value,
           ROUND(elapsed_time / 1000000, 4)                             AS ELAPSED_TIME_SEC,
           executions,
           ROUND(elapsed_time / 1000000 / NULLIF(executions, 0), 4)     AS SINGLE_RUN_SEC,
           SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 400)                                     AS sql_text
    FROM   v$sql
    WHERE  executions > 0
      AND  last_active_time > SYSDATE - 1
      AND  parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','OUTLN','XDB','WMSYS','CTXSYS','MDSYS',
                                         'AUDSYS','OJVMSYS','APPQOSSYS','DVSYS','LBACSYS','ORDSYS','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL')
    ORDER  BY elapsed_time / NULLIF(executions, 0) DESC
)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 100

           l.session_id AS sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.osuser, s.machine, s.program,
           s.status, s.logon_time,
           DECODE(l.locked_mode, 0,'None', 1,'Null', 2,'Row-S', 3,'Row-X',

                  TO_CHAR(l.locked_mode)) AS lock_mode

16.sql:
SELECT a.file_name,
			substr(A.tablespace_name,1,14) tablespace_name,
			trunc(decode(A.autoextensible,'YES',A.MAXSIZE-A.bytes+b.free,'NO',b.free)/1024/1024) free_mb,
			trunc(a.bytes/1024/1024) allocated_mb,
			trunc(A.MAXSIZE/1024/1024) capacity,
			a.autoextensible autoextensible
			FROM (
			SELECT file_id, file_name,
			tablespace_name,
			autoextensible,
			bytes,
			decode(autoextensible,'YES',maxbytes,bytes) maxsize
			FROM   dba_data_files
			GROUP BY file_id, file_name,
			tablespace_name,
			autoextensible,
			bytes,
			decode(autoextensible,'YES',maxbytes,bytes)
			) a,
			(SELECT file_id,
			tablespace_name,
			sum(bytes) free
			FROM   dba_free_space
			GROUP BY file_id,
			tablespace_name
			) b
			WHERE a.file_id=b.file_id(+)
			AND A.tablespace_name=b.tablespace_name(+)
			ORDER BY A.file_name ASC

SPACE_01.sql:
SELECT df.tablespace_name,
       ROUND(100 * (df.alloc_bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0))
             / NULLIF(df.max_bytes, 0), 2) AS "Usage %"
FROM   (SELECT tablespace_name,
               SUM(bytes) AS alloc_bytes,
               SUM(CASE WHEN autoextensible = 'YES' AND maxbytes > bytes
                        THEN maxbytes ELSE bytes END) AS max_bytes
        FROM   dba_data_files
        GROUP  BY tablespace_name) df
LEFT   JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) AS free_bytes
             FROM   dba_free_space
             GROUP  BY tablespace_name) fs ON fs.tablespace_name = df.tablespace_name
ORDER  BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

SPACE_02.sql:
SELECT tablespace_name,
       ROUND(tablespace_size  / 1048576, 2)                             AS "Size MB",
       ROUND(allocated_space  / 1048576, 2)                             AS "Allocated MB",
       ROUND(free_space       / 1048576, 2)                             AS "Free MB",
       ROUND(100 * (tablespace_size - free_space)
             / NULLIF(tablespace_size, 0), 2)                           AS "Used %"
FROM   dba_temp_free_space
ORDER  BY 5 DESC NULLS LAST

98.desc: Top SQL (all in cache) by single execution time

    SELECT parsing_schema_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value,
           ROUND(elapsed_time / 1000000, 4)                             AS ELAPSED_TIME_SEC,

           SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 400)                                     AS sql_text
    FROM   v$sql
    WHERE  executions > 0
      AND  parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','OUTLN','XDB','WMSYS','CTXSYS','MDSYS',

SPACE_03.desc: Worst Tablespace Usage % (single value for trending)
SPACE_03.sql:
SELECT ROUND(MAX(100 * (df.alloc_bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes, 0))
                 / NULLIF(df.max_bytes, 0)), 2) AS "Max Usage %"
FROM   (SELECT tablespace_name,
               SUM(bytes) AS alloc_bytes,
               SUM(CASE WHEN autoextensible = 'YES' AND maxbytes > bytes
                        THEN maxbytes ELSE bytes END) AS max_bytes
        FROM   dba_data_files
        GROUP  BY tablespace_name) df
LEFT   JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) AS free_bytes
             FROM   dba_free_space
             GROUP  BY tablespace_name) fs ON fs.tablespace_name = df.tablespace_name

FROM   v$asm_diskgroup
WHERE  state = 'CONNECTED'

RES_01.desc: Resource Limits (processes, sessions nearing their cap)
RES_01.sql:
SELECT resource_name, current_utilization, max_utilization,
       initial_allocation, limit_value,
       ROUND(100 * current_utilization
             / NULLIF(CASE WHEN TRIM(initial_allocation) = 'UNLIMITED' THEN NULL
                           ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(initial_allocation)) END, 0), 2) AS "Pct Used"
FROM   v$resource_limit
WHERE  resource_name IN ('processes', 'sessions', 'transactions',
                         'enqueue_locks', 'dml_locks', 'parallel_max_servers')
ORDER  BY 6 DESC NULLS LAST

    SELECT owner, job_name, status,
           TO_CHAR(actual_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS started,
           run_duration, error#, SUBSTR(additional_info, 1, 300) AS additional_info
    FROM   dba_scheduler_job_run_details

      AND  actual_start_date > SYSDATE - 7
    ORDER  BY actual_start_date DESC
)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 100

BLOCK_01.sql:
SELECT LPAD(' ', 2 * (LEVEL - 1)) || s.sid AS "Blocking Tree",
       LEVEL AS depth, s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.status,
       s.event, s.wait_class, s.seconds_in_wait, s.sql_id, s.machine, s.program
FROM   v$session s
START  WITH s.blocking_session IS NULL
       AND  s.sid IN (SELECT blocking_session FROM v$session
                       WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL)
CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR s.sid = s.blocking_session
ORDER  SIBLINGS BY s.sid
